title: gentle-desk v2 - direction A, workspaces (the chosen design)
brief: Desktop client for gentle-shell. Chosen direction A: a sidebar of workspaces (folders) with their chats, a New session button that opens a chat in the current workspace folder (disabled when no workspace is selected), a new-chat icon on each workspace that appears on hover or focus, and the Chat | Helpers swap in the same area, shown in both views. Per-chat states, notices, rename/delete and the disabled New session state live in one shared board. Same six gentle-shell themes. Directions B and C were discarded by the user.

artboards.title: Shared states board
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the six per-chat states, notices, rename, delete, the disabled New session state, the empty first-run sidebar and the New workspace menu out of the main screens so those stay silent; cost: you judge states away from the real layout.

artboards.title: A - Workspaces (Chat view)
artboards.tradeoff: Workspaces with their chats and nothing else in the sidebar. New session opens a chat in the current workspace; each workspace shows a new-chat icon on hover or focus. The header New workspace icon opens a two-item menu (Choose an existing folder, Create a new folder). Open or closed folder icon shows the state; no chevron. Not drawn: a workspace menu (no options yet).

artboards.title: A - Workspaces (Helpers view)
artboards.tradeoff: Same sidebar as the Chat view, with the Helpers view swapped into the same area as the thread.
